violations_fixed: V1 ranking window was scored window -> now pre-window only
V2 BTC included in traded top-10 -> now benchmark measurement-only, excluded before ranking
V3 daily-granularity gap_day screen tolerated intra-day holes -> now exact 15-minute census over pre-window AND scored window with mandatory cause per gap; unexplained fails
V4 funding gate rows>=1 -> now held-exposure completeness proof (contiguous legal intervals, boundary coverage from first possible weekly exposure, corroborated interval steps)

selection_window.note: strictly BEFORE the scored window; ranking uses ONLY this window

ranking_metric_detail: median over distinct pre-window UTC bar-days of the daily sum of the 15m parquet native quote_volume (USDT, Decimal-exact); even-count median = mean of the two central values
rank_tiebreak: symbol asc (carried from prior frozen artifact)
btc_exclusion_note: BTCUSDT-PERP.BINANCE (equivalent of PERP.BINANCE.BTC-USDT) is the benchmark, measurement-only; excluded from the ranked/traded universe before ranking
listing_age_rule: onboard_date <= scored-window start minus 365d (= 2024-08-21T00:00:00Z); consistent with prior artifact's >=365d preference; no contradicting frozen prereg found
